verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only narrow background behaviors the product performs on its own. New subscribers can be auto-tagged on sign-up, contacts from other tools land in the right list automatically, and users control what happens after someone signs up. No documented automation or workflow builder (drips, triggered sequences, recurring scheduled runs) appears in the pack, and Zapier is a third-party connector rather than the product's own automation. missing for 10: documented automation workflow builder, triggered/multi-step email sequences, recurring scheduled automations, agentic/AI-driven background execution, independent corroboration.
